claims.claim: The song was on television before the album came out.
claims.assessment: First live television airing was the 2006 MTV Video Music Awards on 31 August 2006; the album followed on 23 October 2006.

claims.claim: Quiz: where did the song get its first live television airing? Options are the 2006 MTV VMAs, the 2007 Grammy Awards and Reading Festival 2006.
claims.assessment: Answer A. The description names the event, so this one is answerable from the copy. Reading Festival 2006 is a real festival appearance in the era and works as a near miss; no claim is made about it.

claims.claim: Artist-wide genres are alternative rock, emo, pop punk and post-hardcore, and this normal long form takes the four long-form genre lists plus Long Form All Genres.
claims.assessment: Artist-level classification used for the whole catalogue, not a per-track claim. Routing follows the standing rule for normal long forms.

distinct_fact_and_source: The first live television airing at the 2006 MTV Video Music Awards on 31 August 2006, six weeks before the album. Unused by the other six. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Welcome_to_the_Black_Parade
uniqueness_assessment: Zero five-word phrases shared with any other package once the song title is set aside. The only remaining signals are against this video's own previous copy file, which this file replaces. Gate returns five signals, all of them the song title.
uncertainties_and_removed_claims: The 2007 Grammy nomination and the Reading Festival 2006 appearance are used only as quiz options and are not asserted anywhere in the description. The live description currently carries a retired Discord invite; the proposal replaces it but no Studio edit is claimed. Current playlist membership and pin state are not asserted.
